description:
A project with its files (names and ids, not content), collaborators,
    ``edit_policy``, ``view_url`` and, for its editors, ``not_served_reason``
    when a published project is not being served. A draft or a project nobody
    else is served answers ``NOT_FOUND`` to anyone but those who may edit its
    files: its owner, collaborators and whoever its ``edit_policy`` lets in.
name: colony_get_project
